1: // Simple endless runner ship game on canvas with id "game"
2: // Ship flies forward; asteroids move toward ship. Arrow keys steer.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   // Audio setup
6:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
7:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
8:   let backgroundOsc = null;
9:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
10:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
13:     osc.type = 'sine';
14:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
15:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     osc.start();
17:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
18:   }
19:   function startBackground() {
20:     if (backgroundOsc) return;
21:     backgroundOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
22:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
23:     backgroundOsc.frequency.value = 30; // low rumble
24:     backgroundOsc.type = 'sine';
25:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
26:     backgroundOsc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
27:     backgroundOsc.start();
28:   }
29:   function stopBackground() {
30:     if (backgroundOsc) {
31:       backgroundOsc.stop();
32:       backgroundOsc.disconnect();
33:       backgroundOsc = null;
34:     }
35:   }
36: 
37:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
38:   if (!canvas) return; // no canvas found
39:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
40: 
41:   const WIDTH = canvas.width;
42:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height;
43: 
44:   // Ship definition with gradient fill
45:   const ship = {
46:     x: WIDTH / 2,
47:     y: HEIGHT * 0.8,
48:     w: 30,
49:     h: 20,
50:     speed: 4,
51:     color: '#0f0',
52: draw() {
53:         // Gradient fill for ship hull
54:         const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x, this.y + this.h);
55:         grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
56:         grad.addColorStop(1, '#0ff');
57:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
58:         // Glow effect
59:         ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
60:         ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
61:         ctx.beginPath();
62:         ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y);
63:         ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.w / 2, this.y + this.h);
64:         ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w / 2, this.y + this.h);
65:         ctx.closePath();
66:         ctx.fill();
67:         // Reset shadow
68:         ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
69:         // Simple thruster flame when moving up
70:         if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
71:           ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
72:           ctx.beginPath();
73:           ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.h);
74:           ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.w / 4, this.y + this.h + this.h / 2);
75:           ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w / 4, this.y + this.h + this.h / 2);
76:           ctx.closePath();
77:           ctx.fill();
78:         }
79:     }
80:   };
81: 
82:   // Starfield background
83:   const stars = [];
84:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
85:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
86:     stars.push({
87:       x: Math.random() * WIDTH,
88:       y: Math.random() * HEIGHT,
89:       size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
90:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2
91:     });
92:   }
93: 
94:   // Asteroid pool
95:   const asteroids = [];
96:   const ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
97:   const ASTEROID_SPEED = 2;
98:   let lastSpawn = 0;
99: 
100:   // Input handling
101:   const keys = {};
102:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
103:     // Ensure audio context is running on user interaction
104:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
105:     startBackground();
106:     keys[e.key] = true;
107:   });
108:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
109: 
110:   let score = 0;
111:   let startTime = null;
112:   let gameOver = false;
113: 
114:   function update(dt) {
115:     // Thruster sound when moving up
116:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
117:       playTone(400, 0.05);
118:     }
119:     // Move ship based on keys
120:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
121:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x += ship.speed;
122:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.y -= ship.speed;
123:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.y += ship.speed;
124:     // Keep within bounds
125:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.w / 2, Math.min(WIDTH - ship.w / 2, ship.x));
126:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(HEIGHT - ship.h, ship.y));
127: 
128:     // Update stars (move down to simulate forward motion)
129:     for (const s of stars) {
130:       s.y += s.speed;
131:       if (s.y > HEIGHT) {
132:         s.x = Math.random() * WIDTH;
133:         s.y = 0;
134:         s.size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
135:         s.speed = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2;
136:       }
137:     }
138: 
139:     // Spawn asteroids
140:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
141:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
142:       const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
143:       const x = Math.random() * (WIDTH - size);
144:       asteroids.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed: ASTEROID_SPEED });
145:     }
146: 
147:     // Update asteroids
148:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
149:       const a = asteroids[i];
150:       a.y += a.speed;
151:       if (a.y > HEIGHT) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
152:     }
153: 
154:     // Collision detection (simple AABB)
155:     for (const a of asteroids) {
156: if (
157:           ship.x - ship.w / 2 < a.x + a.size &&
158:           ship.x + ship.w / 2 > a.x &&
159:           ship.y < a.y + a.size &&
160:           ship.y + ship.h > a.y
161:         ) {
162:           gameOver = true;
163:           playTone(200, 0.3); // collision sound
164:           stopBackground();
165:         }
166:     }
167: 
168:     // Update score (distance traveled = time elapsed)
169:     if (!startTime) startTime = Date.now();
170:     score = Math.floor((Date.now() - startTime) / 100);
171:   }
172: 
173:   function draw() {
174:     // Clear
175:     // Draw space background gradient
176:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
177:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
178:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
179:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
180:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
181: 
182:     // Stars
183:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
184:     for (const s of stars) {
185:       ctx.beginPath();
186:         const radius = s.size;
187:         ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
188:         ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5})`;
189:         ctx.fill();
190:     }
191: 
192:     // Asteroids
193:     // Asteroids with radial gradient
194:     for (const a of asteroids) {
195:       ctx.beginPath();
196:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
197:         a.x + a.size / 2,
198:         a.y + a.size / 2,
199:         a.size * 0.1,
200:         a.x + a.size / 2,
201:         a.y + a.size / 2,
202:         a.size / 2
203:       );
204:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#a52a2a');
205:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
206:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
207:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
208:       ctx.fill();
209:     }
210: 
211:     // Ship
212:     ship.draw();
213: 
214:     // Score
215:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
216:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
217:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
218: 
219:     // Game over overlay
220:     if (gameOver) {
221:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
222:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
223:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
224:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
225:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
226:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 20);
227:       ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
228:       ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 20);
229:     }
230:   }
231: 
232:   let lastTime = 0;
233:   function loop(timestamp) {
234:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
235:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
236:     lastTime = timestamp;
237:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
238:     draw();
239:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
240:   }
241: 
242:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
243: })();
